mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS word_id, w.book_id AS book_id, w.word AS word, w.phonetic AS phonetic, w.translation AS translation, w.example AS example FROM `word_progress` p JOIN `word` w ON w.id = p.word_id AND w.deleted = 0 JOIN `user_word_book` b ON b.user_id = p.user_id AND b.book_id = p.book_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.learned = 1 AND p.next_review_date IS NOT NULL AND p.next_review_date <= #{today} ORDER BY p.next_review_date ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT w.id AS word_id, w.word AS word, w.phonetic AS phonetic, w.translation AS translation, w.example AS example, p.stage AS stage, COALESCE(m.wrong_count, 0) AS wrong_count FROM `word_progress` p JOIN `word` w ON w.id = p.word_id AND w.deleted = 0 JOIN `user_word_book` b ON b.user_id = p.user_id AND b.book_id = p.book_id LEFT JOIN `mistake_entry` m ON m.user_id = p.user_id AND m.word_id = p.word_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.learned = 1 AND p.next_review_date IS NOT NULL AND p.next_review_date <= #{today} ORDER BY p.next_review_date ASC, p.id ASC
